NTH FOOTPRINTS · 0.2.5

The first few steps.

Ready to try

Vertical animated photo-stack browsing; photo GPS previews and geotagging; create, edit, and delete places; photos and voice notes; ratings, favorites, categories, search and sort; GPS capture; a map for each saved coordinate; external directions; local storage; and portable backup/restore.

Still ahead

Android packaging, native home-screen widgets, a map showing all places together, nearby place search, downloadable offline maps, and integrated turn-by-turn navigation.

The supplied references document Footprints and its widget. A separate HTC Locations reference is still needed to complete that feature inventory. Sample artwork is original illustration, not photography from HTC.
